turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got a sunny balcony and I want to grow something I can actually eat.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lovely. Herbs, cherry tomatoes and salad greens all do well in pots. Which of those would you use the most?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me talk to Lucas for a bit, so please stay quiet until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you take the dog out tonight? I have to work late.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, what time does he usually go?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Around seven, and then once more before bed.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Does he pull on the leash? Last time he dragged me toward every squirrel.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Use the harness, it's on the hook by the door. Much better.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done talking to them. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Any thoughts on what to plant first?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Cherry tomatoes. My kids would love picking them.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great choice. Get a big pot, a stake for support, and water them every day when it's hot.
